## Summary

I added two methods to the `Ledger` class in `ledger/entries.py`:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`**: Posts an entry at 23:59:59 on the given date by combining the date with a time of 23:59:59 and delegating to the existing `post()` method.

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`**: Returns all entries posted at or after the given datetime, sorted by `posted_at` (oldest first) to ensure consistent ordering regardless of insertion order.

Both methods integrate cleanly with the existing API and all four existing tests continue to pass.
